issuer: the Ontario Ministry of Transportation, through ServiceOntario and DriveTest
note: Ontario's renewal page (read 2026-10-30) gives the fee as $90 for a 5-year licence, renewed every 5 years; the new-driver page says a new driver practises 12 months on a G1 licence and 12 months on a G2 before the full G, from 16, so a full licence is kept from 18 (17 and 8 months with an approved course, which a whole-year age doesn't hold). The first licence's application and test fees are DriveTest's, whose fee page refused the request behind a Cloudflare check and wasn't read, so the $90 licence fee is the one held. The Photo Card page gives $35, valid for 5 years, for residents 16 or older without a licence.

sources.title: Ontario, Renew your driver's licence
sources.said: The fee is $90 for a 5-year licence. ... You must renew your driver’s licence every 5 years

sources.title: Ontario, Get a G driver’s licence: new drivers
sources.said: If you are at least 16 years old, you can apply for driver’s licence in Ontario. ... In most cases, you practice with your G1 licence for 12 months . ... You practice with your G2 licence for 12 months .

sources.title: Ontario, Ontario Photo Card
sources.said: are 16 years of age or older ... Cost $35 to get or renew your Ontario Photo Card. ... An Ontario Photo Card is valid for 5 years
